description: A spiritual ecosystem connecting devotees with priests, astrology, and pooja marketplace.

design_philosophy.visual_metaphor: The Virtual Temple - Entering a space of sanctity and clarity.
key_principles: Authenticity over Trend: Use traditional motifs (mandalas, lotus) but simplify them for digital consumption.
Warmth is Welcoming: Avoid sterile white. Use cream, parchment, and warm greys.
Cosmic Depth: For astrology, switch to deep indigos and starry backgrounds.
Ritualistic Motion: Interactions should feel deliberate and smooth, not snappy.

typography.guidelines: Use 'Cinzel' for all major section headers to evoke a sense of inscription. Use 'Manrope' for all functional text. Ensure 'special' font is used for any Sanskrit shlokas.

colors.usage_rules: Use Saffron for primary actions (Book, Buy). Use Maroon for headers/footers. Use Gold sparingly for icons or highlights. Backgrounds should generally be 'Cream Parchment' (#FFFDD0) to avoid eye strain and feel organic. Astrology section MUST use 'Cosmic Indigo' theme.

layout.grid_system: The 'Mandala' Grid. Central focus with radiating elements.

container_styles.card: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm border border-orange-100 rounded-2xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF9933] text-white hover:bg-[#CC7000] rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-semibold shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-transform active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: border-2 border-[#800000] text-[#800000] hover:bg-[#800000] hover:text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium transition-colors

cards.service_card: relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-orange-100 bg-gradient-to-br from-white to-orange-50 p-6 hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform
cards.product_card: group relative rounded-2xl bg-white p-4 shadow-sm transition-shadow hover:shadow-md border border-gray-100

textures: Faint mandala patterns in negative space (SVG)
Gold foil gradients for premium text

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px. Use gold or maroon colors.
icons.custom: Use SVG paths for Diyas, Om, Swastika (sacred symbol), and Lotus.

motion.page_transition: Fade in with slight upward drift (duration 0.5s)
motion.loading: Spinning Chakra or pulsing Om symbol

hero_bg.usage: Hero section background with dark overlay for text readability.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic 'Inter' font for headings. Use 'Cinzel'.
Ensure high contrast for accessibility, especially with gold text on light backgrounds.
Mobile-first approach is critical. Navigation should be bottom-bar for mobile.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Initialize the React project with Vite if not present.
3. Configure `tailwind.config.js` with the custom color palette.
5. Implement the `Cinzel` and `Manrope` fonts via Google Fonts.
6. Build the 'Auth' pages first using Firebase UI components styled to match the theme.
7. Develop the 'Devotee Dashboard' with the 'Mandala Grid' layout.
8. Ensure the Astrology section triggers a theme switch to 'Cosmic Mode'.
